study.title: Harnessing UAVs and deep learning for accurate grass weed detection in wheat fields: a study on biomass and yield implications
study.short_title: Grass-Weed Semantic Segmentation in Wheat Fields (DeepLabV3+)

segmentation.domain: weed (grass weeds) vs wheat vs land/soil

dataset.name: Self-built wheat-field grass-weed dataset (Yizheng & Sihong, Jiangsu, 2019-2020)
dataset.note: UAV RGB (DJI Mavic 3, 5280x3956, flight 15 m) + hyperspectral (DJI Matrice 600 Pro + GaiaSky-mini 400-1000 nm, 3.5 nm, flight 50 m) during wintering/seedling/jointing periods; 8 plots (6 infested, 2 weed-free control); weeds Alopecurus aequalis and Poa annua; 1,000 RGB images -> 10,000 sub-images 318x318 (7,000 train / 3,000 validation); manual LabelMe annotation: wheat, weeds, soil. DeepLabV3+ used to compute weed canopy cover (CC) for SVR biomass estimation.

segmentation.backbone: DeepLabV3+: ResNet-50 encoder with ASPP + decoder (low-level 48-ch 1x1 conv fusion)

mIoU.quote: DeepLabV3+ MIoU 88.8 (Weed IoU 83.3, Wheat IoU 87.5, Land IoU 95.6)
mIoU.section: Semantic segmentation effect of weeds / Table 2
mIoU.ambiguity: Per-method mIoU: ResNet-38 76.7, PSPNet 74.2, DeepLabV3 78.4, UNet 84.3, DeepLabV3+ 88.8 (best). Weed/wheat detection precision per sowing method: 91.27% scattered vs 87.51% drilled.

F1.quote: DeepLabV3+ F1 96.8 (Table 2); F1/MIoU/precision/recall above 85 for weed & wheat monitoring
F1.section: Table 2 / Semantic segmentation effect of weeds
F1.ambiguity: Table 2 F1 column: DeepLabV3+ 0.968 (recall 0.906). Text additionally states model F1/MIoU/precision/recall all >85%. Slight inconsistency: per-plot precision 0.9127/0.8751 vs table F1 levels.

PA.ambiguity: Precision/recall reported per class and sowing method, not overall pixel accuracy.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Weed-class IoU 0.833 (DeepLabV3+); weed-specific F1 not separated from Table 2 F1 column.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Wheat-class IoU 0.875 (DeepLabV3+); wheat-specific F1 not isolated.
